activity.role: Naczelnik (Supreme Commander of the National Armed Force)
activity.notes: Kościuszko was not king of the Commonwealth. On 24 March 1794 he became Naczelnik, the single supreme leader of the insurrection with full civil and military authority. His effective command ended when he was wounded and captured at Maciejowice on 10 October 1794.

sources.title: Naczelnik — Muzeum Historii Polski
sources.citation_text: The Museum of Polish History states that Kościuszko swore the uprising oath on 24 March 1794, became its sole supreme leader with full civil and military authority, and was captured after the Battle of Maciejowice on 10 October 1794.
